# Dr Helen Miles

Dr Helen Miles is the current Deputy of [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Dr Helen Miles has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/helen-miles#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 2 with 75.5% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/helen-miles/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hz3mfAQ8ADI)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://www.miles4stbrelade.com/_files/ugd/89004a_ebdaf487e8764f0c954261b35a7bfd29.pdf)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Helen-Miles-Deputy-St-Brelade-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=22)

Dr Helen Miles has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[miles4stbrelade.com](https://www.miles4stbrelade.com/post/deputy-helen-miles-to-stand-for-senator-in-june-election)\]
